I am an economist and Senior Researcher at [Red de Estudios para el Desarrollo (REDES)](https://www.redesarrollo.pe/). My work focuses on public policy analysis and economic regulation, covering topics such as social development, employment, energy, and mining. I have previous experience in regulatory consulting and economic analysis. Additionally, I publish opinion articles in media outlets such as El Comercio and Correo, and I participate in public debates with the goal of bringing clear and accessible evidence to the public discussion.

## Experience

**Red de Estudios para el Desarrollo (REDES)** · Senior Researcher (since 2025), Researcher (2023-2024)\
Applied economic analysis focused on social development, macroeconomics, labor markets, and public policy.

**Semana Económica** · Economic and Financial Analyst (2022-2023)\
Macroeconomic, fiscal, and sectoral policy analysis, authoring over 60 articles and interviewing key public and corporate decision-makers.

**GERENS Graduate School** · Junior Researcher and Consulting Assistant (2020 – 2022)\
Regulatory consulting and economic research in energy, natural gas, and mining for private firms and public agencies (MEF, MINEM, Osinergmin)

**INDECOPI** · Intern, Technical Secretariat for Free Competition (2019 – 2020)\
Technical market studies and competition analysis in maritime freight transport and the port sector.

## Education

**Pontificia Universidad Católica del Perú (PUCP)** · BSc in Economics and Professional Degree of Licentiate in Economics (2014 – 2020)

**Pontificia Universidad Católica del Perú (PUCP)** · Specialisation Diploma in Data Science for Social Sciences and Public Management (2022 – 2023)\
Advanced econometrics, machine learning, big data analytics, geospatial analysis and natural language processing, using Python, R and QGIS.
